name: genealogy-research
description: Evidence-led genealogy research with source verification, DNA guardrails, historical-document analysis, and GEDCOM auditing.

interface.longDescription: Plan and conduct defensible family-history research. Separate claims from conclusions, trace every assertion to its provenance, distinguish independent corroboration from duplicate indexes, analyze documents and DNA responsibly, protect living people, and audit GEDCOM files without modifying them.
defaultPrompt: Build a source-led plan for this ancestor question.
Analyze these records and separate facts from inferences.
Audit this GEDCOM for structure, links, and privacy risks.
